content.rendered:
Friday, August 25th our families will receive an email informing them of who their classroom teacher will be for the 2023-2024 school year. Please be on the look out around 3:15 pm Friday afternoon on August 25th for which classoom your student will be in.

Monday, August 28th we will have a Meet and Greet and you can drop in anytime between 4:00-6:00. At this time you are welcome to bring in your supplies and meet your new teacher for the year. If you purchased you school supplies through EPI those supplies will be in your classroom. Also, at this time the Kona Ice truck will be set up in front of our school. We ask that you enjoy your snow cone outside before coming into the building. The truck will be set up from 4:30-6:30.

For your reference please see the Supply List – English and Supply List – Spanish
